subject: [hw] T01 differential: five NEON kernels fail at arm-O2/O3v; isolated vmul/vmla/vminmax pass
body:
Current run_diff (117 kernels, 7 configs): arm-O0 2340/2340 PASS; arm-O2 125 mismatches, all vector kernels. Failures involving V18 shapes, seed 0 expected/got:

  k_i8_loop       e89cec75 / 8adb7bdc   (20/20 seeds, arm-O2/O3v)
  k_i16_loop      c691caa2 / 352b259d   (20/20)
  k_i16_mul       4baa0f04 / 343a10f4   (20/20)
  k_neon_vmla16   8f1eca99 / 159e837b   (20/20)
  k_u8_sad        9e378199 / 9e378193   (20/20 arm-O2, 7/20 arm-O3v)

Isolated kernels that PASS in the same configs: k_neon_vmul (vmul.i32), k_neon_vmull (smull), k_neon_vmla (vmla.i32), k_neon_vneg, k_neon_vminmax (vmin/vmax), k_neon_vshl (variable), k_neon_vshrn, k_neon_vmovn, k_neon_vldst. So plain vmul/vmla/min/max are fine; the failing disassemblies use vmla.i16 (k_i16_loop), vmull.s16+vadd.i8 vsra.s32 (k_i8_loop), vaddw.s16+vmovl.s16 (k_neon_vmla16), vsubl.u16+vcgt.u16+vbit+vmovl.u8+vld1.32 lane (k_u8_sad), vsubl.u16/vadd.i16/vmovn (k_neon_vsubl, also in the table: 20/20). My minimal vmla.i16/vmla.i32/vadd.i16/vadd.i8/vsubl.u16/vmovl/vshll/vsra tests with low and high d registers all give the expected values, so it is likely a specific form or an interaction; the kernels above reproduce 100%. Please run them with:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/run_diff.sh
(or tell me and I will send the exact disassembly of any kernel). k_neon_vsubl is probably V19 (vsubl) not you; I am posting the same data to V19/V20.
